observations: Photo 0 shows a black metal X-style keyboard stand with four legs and a central crossbar, placed on a tiled floor against a textured wall.
Photo 1 shows a keyboard on the stand, with a beige and black front panel, white and black keys, and a small LCD screen. The keyboard is positioned on a wooden surface.

Photo 2 shows a top-down view of the same keyboard, revealing the full front panel with buttons, a small display, and a label on the right side that appears to say 'Casio'. The keyboard is placed on a gray fabric surface, possibly a couch or chair, with a tiled floor visible.
The keyboard has a standard 61-key layout, typical of a CTK 4200 model.
The stand is black metal, with a simple X-shaped design, and appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.
The keyboard shows some minor wear, including light scuffs on the keys and a small crack or chip on the right side panel in photo 2.
No power adapter or stand is visible in any photo.

read_from: photo 2 label on right side of keyboard

claims.claim: Nearly used Casio CTK 4200 Professional Keyboard with Adapter and Stand

risks.risk: The keyboard may have hidden damage to the internal circuitry or keys.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
